description.value: La Forêt is a cozy café and bakery with roots going back to 2013, grown into a beloved Burnaby and Vancouver destination known for specialty espresso drinks, brunch platters, housemade croissants, and custom cakes. The Royal Oak branch opened in 2023 and offers both indoor and outdoor seating in a welcoming atmosphere. Touring cyclists will find a full food menu with hearty brunch options and a range of hot and iced beverages.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms La Forêt is an active multi-location café and bakery with a Royal Oak Burnaby branch, consistent with the OSM record. OSM tags (indoor_seating=yes, outdoor_seating=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes, diet:vegan=no) are partially corroborated by the website's menu showing vegetarian options such as the Avocado Platter, but bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, and water refill are not mentioned on the website. Pre-order online functionality and a full food menu confirm takeout availability.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café and bakery with confirmed Royal Oak Burnaby location, full food and beverage menu, and online ordering. Clear value to touring cyclists as a food and rest stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website contact page did not surface a phone number or specific street address for the Royal Oak branch, so those fields could not be confirmed via website content. Wi-Fi listed in OSM (internet_access=wlan) but not mentioned on website.

wow_evidence: roots going back to 2013, grown into a beloved Burnaby and Vancouver destination
